sources.name: PubChem
sources.notes: Use compound records as evidence for external identity and applicable structure identifiers. Preserve record-level provenance; source prose/images are not copied into canonical data.

sources.name: ChEBI
sources.notes: Prefer curated records when available and retain CHEBI ID plus attribution.

sources.name: Crystallography Open Database
sources.notes: Use only for crystal-scope records; retain source article attribution even when COD data are CC0.

sources.name: IUPAC / InChI standard
sources.access: Published InChI standard and reference implementation documentation
sources.notes: Standard InChI uses InChI=1S/. It is an identifier, not a replacement for structure-scope classification.

sources.name: RDKit
sources.notes: Deterministic processing tool, not authority. Persist version for derived fields; never persist toolkit objects.

sources.name: Organic v0.1 frozen identity snapshot
sources.access: packages/organic data as frozen v0.1 input snapshot
sources.notes: The 50-entity coverage in this release is a frozen Organic v0.1 snapshot, not a live statement about the organic package's current review status. It does not become a second canonical Structure Registry owner.

sources.name: Inorganic frozen 23-ion seed snapshot
sources.notes: The 23-ion coverage in this release is a frozen seed snapshot. Later inorganic audit revisions trigger new Structure Registry requests/releases rather than silently redefining this published snapshot.
